description: Adds a button to the app's Home for something the person adds often ("Coffee $4", "Walked the dog"). It opens the track's form with these answers filled in, or with instant true adds the row in one tap, dated when it's tapped (then preset must fill every required column but the date).

label.description: What the button says, under 60 characters.

preset.description: Answers by column key, from list_tracks.

name: add_quick_add
title: Add a quick-add button
